## Freeplay

### Description
A rough overview of how to implement freeplay in games using the base package
A detailed document on freeplay behaviours can be found at https://tombola.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/AT/pages/3955359775/Freeplay+client+behaviour

### Basic implementation
if your game doesnt have a bonus game most of the freeplay functionality will work out of the box

if using the new style how to play when the user closes the new player htp you will need to emit this event if the user has freeplay credits
- eventEmitter.emit(events.GLOBAL.FREE_PLAY_EARNED, userModel.freePlayBalance);


### Things to Avoid
- if you are after getting the stake for a game - use the gameModel.stake instead of parsing the response and getting the value for that. gameModel.stake will override the 0 for a freeplay stake so you are able to correctly calculate prizes

- dont forget to add this string to your strings file, it is shown in a toast when the user is already in freeplay and is given more between games, this needs to be added to the root of the json
```json
{
    freePlay: {
        awarded: 'You have been awarded new Free Play credits. These must be used first'
    }
}
```
